podcast.title: First Car CD Player (1984)
podcast.body: Pioneer was the first manufacturer to introduce a CD player for cars, the CDX-1, in 1984. This marked a significant step in bringing digital audio to automotive environments, closely followed by Sony's own offering. `"The first manufacturers to come with something for the car was Pioneer, who introduced the CDX-1 in 1984."`

podcast.title: CDJ Innovation
podcast.body: Pioneer played a pivotal role in the evolution of DJ technology by introducing the CDJ line, specifically the CDJ-1000 in 2001. This machine, a compact disc version of a DJ turntable, became a standard for digital DJing. "nace el CDJ, nace el CDJ, que es el plato de DJ y versión disco compacto, con Pioneer."
